windshield.strip: clear and transparent below the AS-1 line; AS-1 line = the AS-1 mark or 5 in. below the top of the windshield, whichever is closer to the top; no red, yellow or amber above it
same as passenger: clear below the AS-1 line (or 5 in. from top, whichever is closer to the top)

backSide.note: the 20% rule for windows behind the front seat excludes multipurpose vehicles, vans and buses

tint.measuredHow: not stated in statute (light transmission defined relative to light falling on the window, through 'the sunscreening or transparent material')

medicalExemption.text: No medical exemption found in §§ 60-6,257 to 60-6,259

penalty.text: Owner/operator: Class V misdemeanor (no imprisonment, fine up to $100). Installer: Class III misdemeanor (up to 3 months and/or $500).

quotes: If the front side windows have any sunscreening or other transparent material that has a luminous reflectance of more than thirty-five percent or has light transmission of less than thirty-five percent

If the rear window or side windows behind the front seat have sunscreening or other transparent material that has a luminous reflectance of more than thirty-five percent or has light transmission of less than twenty percent except for the rear window or side windows behind the front seat on a multipurpose vehicle, van, or bus
AS-1 line shall mean a line extending from the letters AS-1 ... or shall mean a line five inches below and parallel to the top of the windshield, whichever is closer to the top of the windshield
Any person owning or operating a motor vehicle in violation of section 60-6,257 shall be guilty of a Class V misdemeanor.

helmet.conditions: Since LB138 (2023): helmet optional for operators 21+ who hold a Nebraska Class M license and completed the required course (MSF Basic eCourse if licensed before May 1, 2024; basic motorcycle safety course if licensed on/after) with proof filed with DMV, or who hold another state's motorcycle license; passengers 21+ exempt only if the operator is exempt. Eye protection required for all operators.

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: LPD learner's permit holders may not use any interactive wireless device (secondary enforcement), § 60-4,123; handheld phone ban for commercial and 9-15 passenger vehicles, § 60-6,179.02
handheldPhone.fineText: Texting ban, secondary enforcement: $200 first offense, $300 second, $500 third+ plus points

studdedTires.season: Nov 1 - Apr 1 (studs max 5/16 in. diameter, avg protrusion max 7/64 in.; school buses, mail carriers and emergency vehicles year-round)

radarDetector.note: No state ban found; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)
